decision.reason: [ev-ed0515bb7146] says only that automatic stream sharding is now enabled by default in 3.0.0. A changed default reaches only environments that leave the setting unset, so environments that set it explicitly should be shielded. The proposed condition (every upgrade from below 3.0.0) would flag those shielded environments too, which makes it too broad. The excerpt does not name the configuration key or its old default, so a correct values-key/field unset exposure with a set overlap cannot be built from the evidence. To decide, we need the operations page or the config reference that names the stream-sharding key and its default before 3.0.0.
